rec.name: Collection Page Model View Toggle ("Tragebilder")
rec.status: Built — A/B test set up in Ablyft; ticket marked done (test result not documented)

what.text: A toggle labelled "Model View" (renamed "Tragebilder" after the client's request) sits above the product grid on the collection page. When switched on, product cards swap the product-only image for an on-model (worn) image. It works with theme images and with the collection page card image slider. The screenshot shows the toggle in the top-right of the grid, above the first row of cards. The cards show the product-only shots, price and sale price, color swatches and a quick-add bag button.

why.text: Seeing jewelry on a person shows its real size, how it sits and how it looks when worn. This reduces uncertainty and makes the buying decision easier, so shoppers can judge the product without opening each PDP. A single global toggle also gives shoppers control over what they see. The ticket frames this as the hypothesis that a realistic on-model depiction reduces uncertainty and lifts conversion rate.

how.text: Built as a Sectionfy.io section/feature (linked Sectionfy ticket "CRO | CP | Model View"). Add a toggle above the collection grid. On toggle, JS swaps each card's primary image (or slider image) for the model image. Persist the toggle state across pagination, because the first build reset when moving to page 2. Test on mobile as well, since the first build failed there. For the A/B test, run the control without the toggle against the variant with it, set up in Ablyft with a preview URL parameter. Check the layout of the filter/sort bar and quick-add button, which looked awkward in the preview.

items: Image source: theme product images or the collection card slider

dependencies.text: Sectionfy.io section/functionality. Requires model (worn) images to exist per product, with the model image position in the product media or slider identifiable. The exact mapping rule (e.g. which image counts as the model image) is not documented. A/B tool: Ablyft. Theme with a collection slider on product cards.

images.caption: Mobile collection page with the "Model View" toggle above the product grid, 2-column cards with discount badges, prices, swatches and quick-add button.
Cropped view of the product card slider dots and quick-add button next to the sort bar — the layout issue flagged in review.
